facts.fact: Advocate Johnson Juma says South Sudan's Access to Information Act, enacted in 2013, gives every citizen the right to access official information and records of government.
Advocate Johnson Juma says the Cybercrime and Computer Misuse Provisional Bill is currently in parliament and will regulate online interactions once passed.
facts.system: Cybercrime and Computer Misuse Provisional Bill

systems.system: Cybercrime and Computer Misuse Provisional Bill

SSD.note: Speakers say data is costly but the document gives no price or share of income.
No cut, punishment, repeal or named policy criticised; only a general power to shut down the internet is described.
